recentItems.title: Ex-CNN editor weighs in on AI threats, journalism | The Newsmaker
recentItems.description:
How far should journalists go in using artificial intelligence? 

Former CNN deputy managing editor James 'Jim' LeMay speaks to NewsWatch Plus about the opportunities and risks of AI, the growing threat of disinformation, and why technology should remain a tool—not a replacement for journalists.

Watch the full interview on The Newsmaker.

recentItems.title: Duterte calls for revival of Mindanao-Borneo maritime trade | Playback
recentItems.description:
Vice President Sara Duterte calls for the “practical revival” of legitimate maritime trade between Mindanao and Borneo, supported by safer sea routes, clearer customs procedures and modern border systems.

Speaking at the Davao-Borneo Growth Corridor Forum, Duterte also proposes the creation of a dedicated Mindanao-Borneo team and calls for agreements and concrete commitments that can be delivered before 2030.

recentItems.title: Inside Ukraine: The Sound of War | NewsWatch Presents
recentItems.description:
Halos limang taon na mula nang sumiklab ang giyera sa pagitan ng Russia at Ukraine, patuloy pa ring  umaalingawngaw ang tunog ng mga sirena at babala. 

Sa pagbisita ng NewsWatch Plus sa Kyiv, ang kabisera ng Ukraine, sunod sunod ang drone at missile attacks mula Moscow. 

Paano nga ba ang buhay sa gitna ng giyera at walang humpay na alerto? Narito ang NewsWatch Presents ni Tristan Nodalo.
